correctness.rationale: For stationary two-state exponential run/rest dynamics (b,v,lambda,mu>0), solving the stable forced linear ODE from the infinite past gives Y_d=sum_j w_jU_j with sum w_j<=1. Orthogonal spherical cross-pairs are conditionally uncorrelated and have variance 1/d, proving E[(R_d²-S)²]<=2/d for d>=2. Exponential age transforms give E~Beta(mu/b,1), Z~Beta(lambda/(2b),1); the stationary mixture and contracting perpetuity follow with both rates positive. For upper tail, E<=1/2 gives (eps/2)^{mu/b}, whereas E>1/2 forces three simultaneous small deficits and contributes o(eps^{mu/b}). For lower tail, the small S_R bound and negative-moment bootstrap yield E[S_R^{-p}]<infty for all p=lambda/(2b)>0, and the exact beta-CDF gives pi_T E[S_R^{-p}]eps^p. Mean normalization follows from linear perpetuity moments. Limits d->infty and eps->0 are sequential, as specified; finite simulations alone establish neither.
